title: Restricted D minus S mesh-only generation config with explicit Gmsh algorithm plan, boundary-adaptive sizing and boundary simplification
description: Schema 1.2 keeps the required schema 1.1 mesh_algorithm_plan and adds two required, default-free mesh_generation objects: boundary_adaptive_sizing and boundary_simplification. Schemas 1.0 and 1.1 are unchanged: source D/S vertices are meshed as-is with a uniform default_size_m point size.

projectRelativePath.description: Required project-relative path; absolute paths and parent traversal are rejected.

minimum_face_quality.description: Required normalized minimum face quality, unitless.

default_size_m.description: Required target default mesh size, m.

minimum_size_m.description: Required target minimum mesh size, m; must exceed geometry_tolerance_m and not exceed default_size_m.

area_abs_tolerance_m2.description: Required absolute D-minus-S closure tolerance, m2.

area_rel_tolerance.description: Required relative D-minus-S closure tolerance, unitless.

job_memory_limit_mib.description: Fixed Job Object commit cap, MiB.

algorithm_2d.description: Required Gmsh SDK enum; unit 1 (dimensionless): 5=Delaunay, 6=Frontal-Delaunay. No default.

smoothing.description: Required fixed Gmsh Mesh.Smoothing option, one smoothing pass. No default.

algorithm_switch_on_failure.description: Required fixed Gmsh Mesh.AlgorithmSwitchOnFailure option. Disables hidden algorithm fallback. No default.

optimizer.description: Required post-generation operation. No default or fallback.

iterations.description: Required iteration count; 0 for none and 1 for Relocate2D. No default.

force.description: Fixed false so discrete entities are not force-optimized.

entity_scope.description: The active surface tag is bound internally; callers cannot supply entity tags.

boundaryAdaptiveSizing.description: Required in schema 1.2; no defaults. When enabled, each outer/hole ring vertex (cyclic) and open constraint vertex gets a local target size equal to its shortest adjacent configured segment, clamped to [minimum_size_m, default_size_m]. Vertices below default_size_m are grouped into power-of-two bins (2^floor(log2(size)), clamped to minimum_size_m); each bin adds one Gmsh Distance+Threshold field growing linearly from the bin size at the vertex to default_size_m at distance (default_size_m - bin)/grading_ratio. Boundary vertices are never moved, added or removed; Mesh.MeshSizeExtendFromBoundary stays 0. When disabled, generation is identical to schema 1.1.

grading_ratio.description: Required linear size-growth rate away from short boundary segments, m of target size per m of distance (unitless m/m). Legal range [0.05, 1.0]; smaller values give smoother grading and more faces. No default.

boundarySimplification.description: Required in schema 1.2; no defaults. When enabled, ring edges of source D (exterior and holes) and every source S part shorter than minimum_vertex_spacing_m are collapsed shortest-first by dropping one endpoint. A collapse is accepted only if every source vertex it represents stays within minimum_vertex_spacing_m of the new edge, no ring edge is crossed or touched, no other vertex is enclosed, protected open boundary-group/constraint vertices are kept and each ring keeps >= 3 vertices. On S only reflex/collinear vertices may be dropped, or a convex short S edge is merged into the outward corner where its neighbouring edges meet, so simplified S always contains source S. Edges that cannot be collapsed safely are kept. The mesh and all coverage/closed-wall audits use the simplified D-S; the source audit records per-ring vertex counts, area change, Hausdorff offset and the source-S overlap (required 0 within area tolerance). When disabled, geometry is identical to schema 1.1.

minimum_vertex_spacing_m.description: Required edge-length threshold and maximum accepted source-vertex offset, m. Legal range (0, 50] m and greater than geometry_tolerance_m. No default.

source_manifest.description: Dispatcher-retained source-manifest path/hash/stat identity. Component geometry is never trusted from the output bundle.

target_coordinate_system.description: Required projected target CRS in metres; source CRS declarations are explicit in the source manifest.

expected_gmsh_version.description: Required exact installed Gmsh version in canonical 4.minor.patch form, minor >= 11, without leading zeros or suffixes.
